Banking on your side of the table.

 
 

Why we founded PEAK.

 

We started PEAK in 2016 because we believed in a better way to bank. We believe in serving clients with integrity and a deep commitment to outcomes.

We fight for every deal, determined to deliver the best results to hardworking founders. Even as we grow, we maintain our scrappy roots and hunger to win.

 

Our People

We built the team we wanted to join. With extensive investment banking experience, startup-style scrappiness, and a passion for partnering with founders, we’re energized by the new challenges that each deal throws our way.
